name: Pork Tenderloin
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO. Choose lean cuts and avoid high-fat preparations that may slow digestion.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Marinate with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Cook to internal temperature of 145°F for food safety
Slice against the grain for tender texture
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B-vitamins, especially B6 and B12
Good source of selenium and phosphorus
Low in saturated fat compared to other pork cuts
